v1_sleep_family.scriptContent:
"{{flow.first_name}}, I also want to share with you something that Dr. Bredesen recommends everyone over 60 also take each day for their cognitive and emotional health...

That’s why the doctor developed his nightly sleep supplement for seniors called Sleep Now. v1_closing.label: Closing Read
v1_closing.scriptContent:
"{{flow.first_name}} , just as a reminder, It usually takes people 1-2 months of consistent usage of NeuroQ to see its full effects, Everyone is different, and results will vary from person to person. The key is to maintain consistent use every day to see best results.

Now I would like to go ahead and confirm your order, OK? (Wait for answer)

OK great {{flow.first_name}}. I'd just like to confirm that you've ordered

{{cart.items_summary}}

Your name, as it appears on your card is {{flow.billing_address.firstName}}

{{flow.billing_address.lastName}}. Your address is {{flow.billing_address.address1}} {{flow.billing_address.address2}} {{flow.billing_address.city}}, {{flow.billing_address.state}} {{flow.billing_address.zip}} and your phone number is

{{flow.billing_phone}}. Your total today including Tax that will be charged to your account is ${{cart.first_payment}} under the company name LifeSeasons. Is all your information correct? (Wait for affirmative)

You'll see a charge on your credit card statement saying “NeuroQ 833-638-7674”

{{flow.autoship_confirm}}

{{flow.autoship_note}}

For security purposes and to confirm I have your approval for this order and you agree to the terms, please read back the last four digits of the method of payment you have provided today."

(AGENT: THE LAST FOUR #’S MUST BE THE SAME AS THE #’S OF THE ACCOUNT PREVIOUSLY PROVIDED: captured securely by keypad — not visible to you; if the caller’s digits don’t sound right, use Change Payment Info after authorization )

Message and data rates may apply and you can reply STOP anytime. Can I go ahead and set that up for you?"
